div.div:
on an error step 6.5 and 6.6 do not run. The inner catch copies the error text into the summary, the guard of step 4 writes the summary with status="fail", the outer catch logs the text, the exit code is 1.
on success the summary says success, the delayed .gal files are written (only if their text changed), and stale files of delete-if-not-rewrited stores are removed.
